companionHint: Lumi, your study sidekick. Move your cursor and watch me follow. Click again for a different move! Keyboard: Enter or Space.
mergeHint: Choose 2 or 3 parts, then arrange them from top to bottom. A new lesson combines their audio and slides. Originals stay unchanged. Speech is normalized to mono; gaps between recordings are not inserted. Transcribe the new lesson to make combined notes.
mergeCancelled: Merge cancelled. Original recordings are unchanged.
mergeFailed: Merge failed. Original recordings are unchanged.
mergeDone: Merged lesson saved. Select Transcribe to create its notes.
slidesPending: End recording, then Recover / export to rebuild the slide gallery.
statusBody: Open LectureLens in Chrome → Preview your lesson → Choose slide area in the large editor → Start recording.
nextTitle: A private space for your lessons
nextBody: Select your lesson tab in Chrome, preview it, choose the slide area, and record.
deleteConfirm: Permanently delete this session and its raw recording?
stopRequested: Stop requested. Keep Chrome open while the final chunks are saved, then refresh.
sessionHelp: Select a session to view its slides, recover saved audio, or manage the recording.
empty: Your first lesson starts in Chrome.
includeSlidesHint: Images appear beside speech notes matched by time. Images stay local.
keyLabel: NVIDIA notes API key (leave blank to keep the saved key)
modelLabel: NVIDIA model · Nemotron 3.5 Super for quality / Lightning for speed
keySaved: AI connection settings saved on this PC.
consentNeeded: Allow the transcript upload before generating AI notes.
extensionHelp: One-time development setup: enable Developer mode, choose Load unpacked, then paste the folder path copied to your clipboard. Chrome requires this confirmation. Store installation will be available after publication.
extensionUnavailable: Run npm run dev to prepare the extension first.

heading: Your next breakthrough.

libraryHint: Select a lesson to read its transcript and create a study guide.
workspaceHint: Your transcript, slides and study guide. All together.
captureHint: Choose a browser tab or a desktop app.
notesHint: Turn the transcript and selected slides into a clear study guide.
transcriptMissing: Choose the teacher language and transcription method.
renameHint: Give this lesson a name you will remember.
noPdf: Generate a study guide for this lesson first.

sourceReady: Saved locally and ready to use.
audioHint: Groq handles transcription to keep CPU and memory use low. Optional automatic capture cropping uses Gemini screenshots.
cloudConsent: Use cloud AI for this PDF (sends transcript to NVIDIA).
readyStatus: Ready · Your recordings stay on this device.
retention: Keep original audio and slide captures
retentionConfirm: Your PDF and lesson transcript are saved separately. Delete the original audio and slide captures now?
scope: Groq receives audio for transcription. NVIDIA receives transcript text for notes. During automatic capture cropping, Gemini receives occasional full-tab screenshots.
cancelBeforeClose: Cancel the current operation before closing LectureLens.
offlineLanguageMismatch: Offline notes keep the original language. Match the output language to the spoken language, or enable cloud AI.
audioConsent: For this job, I agree to send this lesson’s audio to Groq. Images stay local.
audioConsentRequired: Allow audio upload for this job, or turn off cloud transcription to work offline.
speechKeyRequired: Add your Groq key in AI connections before cloud transcription.
speechKeyLabel: Groq speech API key (leave blank to keep saved key)
speechFreeHint: Use a Groq Free Plan key. Account limits apply; no automatic paid upgrade. Audio is processed externally; provider retention settings apply.
automaticAiHint: Groq transcribes audio, then NVIDIA creates the study guide. Missing connections are requested when needed.
getGroqKey: Create a free Groq API key
exportDefaults: Recorded slides and original lesson files are included and kept by default. Use Review slides to hide images without deleting the originals.
replaceTranscript: Transcribe this lesson again? The existing transcript will be replaced only after success. Previous PDF exports stay available.
pdfReadyHint: Your study notes have been saved. Choose what to do next.
browserUnavailable: No supported browser was found. Open the file location instead.
